prerequisites: Use an appropriately vendor-patched cluster; conditional known fixes are tabulated below and in docs/compatibility-review.md.
Unsupported/post-baseline features require manual migration. PV topology labels require manual scheduling review; do not delete them to bypass the guard.
CSI drivers, attachment limits, mount/relabel/ID-mapped filesystem support and hardware/runtime profiles require operator validation.
Valid credentials, actual workload-SA SCC rights, working registry/mirrors/image trust and image-pull credentials are required.
HTTP and Endpoint UID checks do not prove UDP, external-gateway, secondary-network or every CNI traffic path; use application-specific checks.
Preflight is a point-in-time assessment; it reserves no quota/capacity and cannot guarantee later admission, image pull or startup.
